last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 139
last_episode_to_air.overview: YAN refuses to be taken away by the messenger of death. To his surprise, the latter covers his ears and then disappears all of a sudden. YAN wakes up. WAN, NING-ON and their friends are having a meeting about their wedding at Warehouse. Everybody knows that a difficult job is ahead when they see the run-down of their wedding. The big day has come. TUNG can see that NING-ON is absent-minded. NING-ON suddenly feels that it is not necessary for her to get married so soon. She would like to tell TUNG this yet she is not around. Secretly, she leaves. FONG discovers that KEI has accused her of having an affair in front of their relatives. Furious, she announces divorcing him in front of the guests. Putting on an old-styled outfit, KEI waits for FONG in front of their building, preparing to take her for a ride in his motorbike.

name: Til Love Do Us Lie
overview: Career woman KAN YIK-PO (Sheung Tin Ngor) turns housewife unwillingly with the sudden resignation of her domestic helper. Being the only breadwinner in the family and faced with a restructuring at work, her husband, SUEN KA-ON (Cheung Siu Fai), finds himself on the verge of a mid-life crisis. PO’s younger sister, KAN YIK-TAN (Joyce Tang), is a devil-may-care woman. The fact that she has recently broken up with her boyfriend does not discourage her from starting another relationship. Quite the contrary, she marries Malaysian Chinese NG LOK-YAN (Hanjin Tan), a guy she merely knows about, and takes him back to Hong Kong. Come and see how intriguing and fun living in a household with culture shock under the same roof can be!
